summary: Iter 356 rail-nav + marketing-truth + double-fetch review. Backend live locks (4/4) pass: /usage/public/stats returns real_developers=2 (test-account excluded from 300+ raw users) & commits_shipped as ints; /admin/qa/cleanup-e2e-sessions is admin-gated (401 unauth) and deletes seeded prod-e2e-* debris; GET /chat/sessions excludes seeded prod-e2e-* sessions server-side. Frontend rail flow verified end-to-end on preview: rail-shell + all 5 icons render on /dashboard, chat flyout opens with zero prod-e2e session leaks, Escape closes it, rail-new-chat present, Ship→Deploy nav preserves rail, Insights/Settings/Admin flyout links all present, /integrations page has integrations-back-btn which navigates back to /dashboard. Landing social-proof reads '2 developers using ORA / 55% cheaper than Copilot' with NO '500+' or '12k+' anywhere. TWO REGRESSIONS FOUND: (1) DOUBLE-FETCH FIX did NOT hold — /chat/sessions fires ~12 times on initial /dashboard load (4×project_id=home + 8×project_id=p_demo_a) instead of the expected ONE. (2) Admin sub-pages /admin/financials, /admin/suggestions, /admin/api-keys render blank (innerText length = 0) and trigger a cascade of HTTP 429 responses + a React 'Lazy → RenderedRoute' error boundary; /admin overview + /admin/users load fine.

action_items: Fix duplicate /chat/sessions fetches on /dashboard initial load. Static lock passes but live network shows 12 calls per load — investigate RailShell chat-flyout data fetch, Shell repo/project switching effect, and any provider-level useEffect that re-runs per project. Add a network-level lock test that asserts <=1 call within first 3s after login.

Fix blank admin sub-pages (/admin/financials, /admin/suggestions, /admin/api-keys). React lazy chunk is throwing; combined with 429 rate limit responses from admin APIs breaking the components. Add error-boundary fallback + retry/backoff on admin API calls, and investigate whether admin rate-limit is being applied too aggressively to founder token.
Consider raising or exempting founder/admin tokens from the endpoint rate-limit that produced the 429 cascade during normal admin panel navigation.

rca of the issue: Double-fetch regression: Shell.jsx has exactly one refreshSessions useEffect (static lock passes), but the RailShell chat-flyout and the project switcher both mount and each triggers project-scoped fetches. When 'home' project loads then 'p_demo_a' becomes active, multiple listeners (RailShell chat group, Shell sidebar, chat provider hook) each fire a fetch, and each project change re-triggers. Result: 4× home + 8× p_demo_a. Fix: dedupe at the fetch layer (SWR/React Query with dedupe key = `sessions:${projectId}`) OR consolidate into a single provider that other components subscribe to. Admin blank pages: React.lazy chunk for the sub-routes throws an unhandled error (visible in console: 'The above error occurred in one of your React components: at Lazy'). Preceded by /api/aurem-dev/admin/... 429 responses, so likely the fetch throws on non-2xx and no error boundary catches → blank. Fix: (1) add ErrorBoundary around admin lazy routes with useful fallback; (2) handle 429 explicitly with retry-after; (3) verify founder/admin token bypasses admin-panel rate limiting.
